## Details
### **SW-REQ-NMEA-001** — GGA Sentence Parsing

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall parse GGA sentences into latitude, longitude, altitude, satellite count, and fix quality.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-038 and SW-REQ-SYS-039: GGA is the primary NMEA carrier of WGS-84 geodetic position and altitude. The five fields are bundled into one requirement because the public API ingests one sentence and returns one populated struct in a single observable I/O call; splitting per-field would not reflect a separately observable behavior at the library boundary.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-038
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-002** — RMC Sentence Parsing

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall parse RMC sentences into latitude, longitude, ground speed, course, and UTC time.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-028: RMC carries UTC time and ground-speed/course needed for downstream nav and time alignment. The five fields are bundled into one requirement because the public API ingests one sentence and returns one populated struct in a single observable I/O call; splitting per-field would not reflect a separately observable behavior at the library boundary.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-028
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-003** — Checksum Validation

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall validate the embedded checksum of each NMEA sentence before producing parsed output.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-038: downstream geodetic position consumers require parsed-output integrity, so the checksum is verified on every sentence to prevent corrupted bytes from polluting reported lat/lon/altitude.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-038
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-004** — Reject Sentences with Invalid Checksum

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall return an error status when a sentence checksum does not match.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-038: parsed geodetic position must be trustworthy, so the parser surfaces checksum failures as an error status enabling callers to discard tainted data rather than emit corrupted lat/lon downstream.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-038
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-005** — Decimal Geodetic Coordinate Output

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall convert latitude and longitude from degrees-minutes format to a single geodetic decimal value.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-038: NMEA emits ddmm.mmmm; downstream consumers require a single decimal scalar in WGS-84. This requirement is the unit-conversion contract (degrees-minutes to decimal degrees), distinct from SW-REQ-NMEA-001 which is the field-extraction contract for GGA.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-038
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-006** — Altitude Reported in Meters

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall report parsed altitude in meters.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-039 and SW-REQ-SYS-042: altitude unit must be preserved as meters (SI) for downstream HAE interpretation.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-039
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-007** — Ground Speed Converted to SI Units

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall convert ground speed from knots to meters per second in parsed output.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-042: NMEA RMC reports speed in knots; FSW SI units mandate conversion at the parser boundary.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-042
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-008** — UTC Time Extraction

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall extract UTC time of fix from each parsed sentence containing it.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-028: GPS UTC time logging requires the parser to surface UTC from GGA and RMC.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-028
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-009** — Sentence Type Identification

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall identify the sentence type of each input message before parsing it.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-028: extracting UTC requires discriminating GGA from RMC (and other types) so the parser dispatches sentence-type-specific field extraction before producing UTC output.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-028
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-010** — POSIX and Pico2 Parser Equivalence

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall produce identical parsed outputs on POSIX and Pico2 builds for identical inputs.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043: as a pure parser the library must be byte-equivalent across both build targets.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-011** — Deterministic Parsing

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall produce deterministic parsed outputs given identical input sentences.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044: parser determinism is required for repeatable Trick sim and regression analysis.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-NMEA-012** — Reject Malformed Fields

- **Description:** The NMEA library shall return an error status when a sentence field is malformed or out of bounds.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044: deterministic FSW outputs require the parser to reject non-numeric, oversized, or otherwise malformed fields with an error status rather than silently emit garbage values that would corrupt downstream determinism.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
